response.rationale: Both answers are valid for the stated sense. “Siaran pers” is standard Indonesian for press release. Malaysian Malay uses “kenyataan media” for an official media statement/press release; “siaran akhbar” is also a valid alternative, but its existence does not make the answer incorrect. The different-common-word relation is appropriate, and no false-friend contrast is needed.
